how_to_apply: Download the official notification PDF and application format from the link below.
Fill out all required details in the prescribed application format.
Prepare a detailed CV and a Statement of Purpose within 500 words.
Gather self-attested copies of all educational certificates/degrees and work experience certificates.

faq.question: Q1. What is the NFDI Chief Executive Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification released by the NIFT Foundation for Design Innovation (NFDI) to hire 1 Chief Executive Officer (CEO) on a 3-year contract basis in NCR.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for NFDI CEO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Chief Executive Officer post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NFDI CEO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The proposed last date for the submission of applications is 30.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for NFDI CEO?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a minimum Post Graduate degree preferably in Design, Technology, or Management, with extensive experience in business administration (minimum ten years of relevant experience).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NFDI CEO position?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is not more than 55 years, with age relaxations applicable for SC, ST, OBC, and PWD candidates as per Govt. of India norms.
